primitives.name: Perceptual Binding Isomorphism
primitives.verbatim_quote: still exist inside of the perception and form a constituent thereof.
primitives.assumptions: Cortical neurons fire in synchronized patterns; perceptual binding occurs via recurrent thalamo-cortical loops.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Synchronized firing fails due to lesions or neuromodulatory depletion, causing perceptual dissociation.

layer2.mapping: Bayesian belief propagation over hidden Markov models; perceptual binding corresponds to posterior probability mass function over latent object.
layer2.telemetry: Neural gamma-band oscillations (30-100 Hz) and multi-unit spiking coherence.

primitives.name: Sensation vs Perception Duality
primitives.verbatim_quote: The sensation is one thing and the perception another, and neither can take place at the same time with the other, because their cerebral conditions are not the same.
primitives.assumptions: Sensory transduction and perceptual construction occur in distinct hierarchical stages; temporal integration windows differ by orders of magnitude.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Temporal blindsight; patients perceive stimuli presented before conscious awareness due to feedforward processing completion.

layer2.mapping: Conformal prediction intervals; sensation maps to observation space, perception maps to hypothesis space over causal models.
layer2.telemetry: Electrophysiological latency differences between early visual cortex (S1) and later inferotemporal cortex (PIT).

primitives.name: Associative Irradiation Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: The chief cerebral conditions of perception are the paths of association irradiating from the sense-impression, which may have been already formed.
primitives.assumptions: Synaptic plasticity modifies connection strengths; prior knowledge biases current perceptual interpretation through top-down predictive coding.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Top-down predictions fail due to noise or pathology, leading to hallucinations or perceptual illusions.

layer2.mapping: GSE state-transition kernel; associative irradiation defines transition probabilities from sensory evidence to hypothesized objects.
layer2.telemetry: fMRI BOLD response magnitude in prefrontal cortex during memory-guided tasks.

primitives.name: Figured Consciousness Principle
primitives.verbatim_quote: In other words, all brain-processes are such as give rise to what ue may call FIGURED consciousness.
primitives.assumptions: Cortical columns process information in modular, coherent chunks; consciousness emerges from integrated activity across distributed networks.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Neural avalanches collapse into fixed points, producing fragmented or hyper-focused conscious states.

layer2.mapping: Bayesian model averaging over structured hypotheses; figured consciousness corresponds to posterior distributions over object categories.
layer2.telemetry: Neural complexity index derived from EEG entropy measures.
